id: title:Gilbert09:treat a deprecated legacy table view as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and operational guidance for BigQuery connector
review.reason: Adds a specific, non-retryable error classification for BigQuery's 'Deprecated legacy table/view' response, including a user-facing message and a parametrized unit test. This distinguishes a deterministic configuration mismatch from transient failures, preventing unnecessary retries and providing actionable guidance to users. review.uncertainty: The actual production impact depends on the frequency of this specific BigQuery deprecation error and the current behavior of the ingestion system, which are not established by this patch alone.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error category and its user-facing message, and a corresponding test, for BigQuery responses indicating a deprecated legacy table/view.
observations.code_quote: "Deprecated legacy table/view": "BigQuery rejected a query for this source because the table or view it reads has been marked deprecated by your BigQuery team, in favor of a newer replacement. Retrying won't help — please update this source to sync the replacement table or view, then reconnect the source.",
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog warehouse ingestion jobs to distinguish between transient failures and a deterministic schema mismatch caused by BigQuery's deprecation guard, preventing unnecessary retries and guiding users to update their source configuration.

observations.behavior: Adds a parametrized unit test asserting that the new error string is recognized as non-retryable regardless of project or job ID, while excluding other unrelated errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the new error classification, ensuring the warehouse ingestion system does not falsely classify transient errors as non-retryable or fail to recognize the deprecation error.
